 October 13, 2026 at 3:00 am CDT By Alex T. Paschal Expand Autoplay Image 1 of 4 Sixth graders from Eastland Elementary School visit the Mobile Museum of Tolerance on Tuesday, Oct. 13, 2026, at Sauk Valley Community College. The lesson plan was combating online hate speech and promoting mental health. (Alex T. Paschal)
